invariants.rationale: If and only if b is zero, the result is Integer.MIN_VALUE.
If and only if b is not zero, the result is a / b.
If b is not zero, result equals a/b, hence result*b equals a minus the remainder of integer division.
If result is not Integer.MIN_VALUE, then b must not be zero.
If b is not zero, result must be a / b; otherwise, b is zero.
